decision.reasoning_trace: I initially filtered the product feed to remove accessories such as travel cases, straps, and chargers, which made up a large portion of the results. My consideration set included a mix of premium (JBL Pulse 4), mid-range (JBL Charge 4 Renewed), and budget-friendly, highly-rated models (Altec Lansing, XENEO, and Comiso). I chose the JBL Charge 4 (Renewed) as the final choice. Despite being a refurbished product, its 4.7-star rating suggests high reliability, and it offers the best balance of professional audio quality and price compared to the more expensive Pulse 4 or the lower-tier budget models.
